hero:
Above, a plague.
Below, something worse.
A 2D horror action-platformer by Zirkon Games, with a dark, illustrated Gothic mining style. Survive a world of plague, war and demons deep beneath America.
story:
A plague. Two front lines.
An ancient enemy.
America, {year}. A devastating plague drives people deep underground. In abandoned gold mines, makeshift settlements take shape among timber supports, railway tracks, lanterns and dark shafts.
But even underground, the war does not end: Union and Confederate forces fight across divided mine sectors for food, coal and control.
As people struggle to survive, something ancient awakens in the depths. Demons, the undead and corrupted miners crawl out of forgotten tunnels.
You are a lone survivor and demon hunter. Fight through dangerous mine shafts, gather gold, clear new paths and confront the horrors beneath the earth.
map: Choose a marker to uncover a place, its people, and what waits in the dark.
Five places. Three human factions. One common threat.
World concept · Names and depths are illustrative
locations: Driven underground by the plague, civilians have built a fragile refuge between timber beams and cold stone. Families and miners survive by lantern light, caught between two warring factions.
Learn which parts of the caverns are held by the Union and the Confederacy. The people of the settlement offer your first glimpse into the divided mine.
Blue uniforms stand behind timber barricades. Union soldiers hold the northern access tunnels. Whoever controls the supply routes has power, even this far below ground.
Find the connections between the occupied tunnels. Keep a route back to the civilian settlement in mind.
Confederate soldiers have entrenched themselves on the other side of the mine. They share neither supplies nor trust with the Union. The creatures below threaten both camps.
Follow the old tracks through the rival territories. Every crossing brings another uncertain encounter.
Buckled rails disappear beneath collapsed beams. A handcar sits idle in the dust. Among the remains of the gold rush lie the parts that could make the next journey possible.
Clear the rubble, reconnect the tracks and recover machinery. The railway could become the settlement’s lifeline.
The last timber supports end at a glowing fracture in the rock. Here, there are no human front lines. Only demons, the restless dead, and sounds no living throat should make.
Light the way. Face the dark.
Look beyond the reach of your lantern. The deepest tunnels hide the greatest threat — and the longest journey home.
features:
Your light. Your tools.
Your way back.
A single-player experience built around combat, exploration and survival.
Explore abandoned gold mines, shafts and underground settlements. Mine for gold, clear blocked passages and uncover forgotten routes.
Build and use rails, lamps and mining equipment. Make your way through the depths and bring light to abandoned tunnels.
Fight demons, undead and corrupted miners with period weapons, dynamite and tools. Atmospheric lighting and threatening shadows make every descent uncertain.
